roms.name: /e/OS
requirements: The /e/OS install guide lists SM-G965F, SM-G965F/DS, SM-G965N as supported; the current ROMinit device record lists SM-G965F only.
Use the latest Android 10 stock firmware for this model, as required by the /e/OS guide.
OEM unlocking and bootloader unlock are required; unlocking and formatting data erase user data.
After flashing the /e/OS Recovery, boot directly into it, format data, then sideload the matching A15 package. Do not relock the bootloader.
Before connecting for the second stage, manually select Apply Update → Apply from ADB in /e/OS Recovery; the stage does not start the TWRP-specific auto-sideload mode.

risk.why: The recovery image identifies Linux 4.9.337, but the official device metadata names the kernel repository without a publicly readable build branch; source review remains unverified.

roms.notes: Official /e/OS infrastructure package. The download directory and package filename identify this as official, while the current device YAML reports release_type: community; channel metadata conflicts. Status is kept at beta pending resolution. Linux 4.9.337 was read from the matching official recovery image. Current exact kernel/device source branch was not publicly inspectable on 2026-10-16.

stages.title: Flash /e/OS Recovery
stages.warning: Writes the RECOVERY partition. Boot directly into /e/OS Recovery afterwards; do not boot Android first.
stages.done: Recovery written. Hold Volume Up + Bixby + Power to boot directly into /e/OS Recovery.

stages.title: Sideload /e/OS
stages.warning: Before connecting, manually select Factory reset → Format data in /e/OS Recovery; this erases all user data. Then choose Apply Update → Apply from ADB. The latest Android 10 firmware must be installed first.
stages.done: /e/OS package sideloaded. Follow the recovery prompts to reboot into the installed system.
